records.tagline: On-brand individual photos of your whole team in 60s
records.description: Turn your team's selfies into consistent, on-brand professional headshots. - You set the brand style (with or without logo, placement of the logo, clothing style and colors, etc) - You invite your team members - Your team uploads 2-3 selfies - Your teams sets the user editable parts (eg colors, pose) Boom... realistic on-brand professional photos in 60 seconds. You can see all the photos is your team dashboard.

records.name: UltraTrader
records.tagline: The #1 Automated Trading Journal For Serious Traders
records.description: Fully Automated Trading Journal UltraTrader automatically syncs trades from 10+ platforms and brokers, including Binance, BYBIT, MetaTrader (MT4/MT5), KuCoin, MEXC, Bitget, and more. Import thousands of trades in seconds; no manual entry required. The ultimate automated trading journal for serious traders.

records.name: ContractAI
records.tagline: AI-powered legal contracts in 60 seconds. No lawyer needed.
records.description: ContractAI generates professional, legally-formatted contracts using AI. No templates. Answer a few questions and get a polished PDF + editable DOCX in 60 seconds. ✓ 6 contract types: NDA, Employment, Contractor, Service, Rental, Bill of Sale ✓ All 50 US states + international ✓ PDF + editable DOCX output ✓ Free tier: 1 contract/month ✓ Premium: $19.99/month (50% less than LegalZoom) Early adopter special: $14.99/month locked forever (first 100 customers).

records.name: TextPorta - E-Book Translation Platform
records.tagline: Translate your e-books into 240 languages. Quick and easy
records.description: Just upload your e-book and pick from 240 translation languages. Convert between 30+ e-book formats. On any device, anywhere. Your translation is ready in seconds. Build your own translation library and download the originals or translated versions whenever you want. You can also read your translations right away using the built-in e-book reader.

records.name: ClawBridge
records.tagline: The Mobile Dashboard for OpenClaw.
records.description: Monitor your OpenClaw autonomous agents from your pocket. Zero-config, secure, and open source. - ⚡ Live Terminal: Watch agent thoughts and tool calls stream in real-time. - 🧠 Memory Browser: Read daily logs and long-term memories via a timeline. - 🎯 Mission Control: Track active tasks, sub-agents, and background jobs. - 📊 Token Analytics: Real-time cost tracking & usage stats per model. - 🌐 Zero-Config Tunnel: Built-in Cloudflare Tunnel. No port forwarding needed.

records.name: All Cloud Hub
records.tagline: Manage all your cloud storage accounts from one dashboard
records.description: All Cloud Hub lets you connect and manage multiple cloud storage accounts from one simple dashboard. Browse, search, organize, and transfer files across services like Google Drive, OneDrive, and Dropbox without switching apps. Your files stay in your own cloud accounts and are accessed securely using official authentication. Built for freelancers, teams, and professionals who want faster access, better control, and an effortless way to manage all their cloud files in one place.

records.name: CollabCord
records.tagline: Track deals. Hit deadlines. Get paid.
records.description: Built for UGC creators who mean business. Track deals, hit deadlines, and stay in control with a powerful dashboard and calendar. Manage deliverables, send professional invoices, monitor payments, and see your earnings in real time. Everything in one place, so you can run your creator business with clarity and get paid on time.

records.name: WebMCP
records.tagline: Give AI agents access to web apps via JavaScript
records.description: A new JavaScript interface that allows web developers to expose their web application functionality as "tools", i.e. JavaScript functions with natural language descriptions and structured schemas that can be invoked by AI agents, browser assistants, and assistive technologies. WebMCP enables collaborative workflows where users and agents work together within the same web interface, leveraging existing application logic while maintaining shared context and user control.

records.name: Lemonade Password Manager
records.tagline: Simple, secure, with an Env Vault for your .env files
records.description: I got frustrated with password managers that feel like enterprise software. So I built the one I actually wanted. Lemonade keeps passwords,env files and API keys in one AES-256-GCM encrypted vault. TOTP, Passkeys, Emergency Access, Secure Notes, Chrome & Firefox extensions. No desktop app — it's a PWA. Free for 15 passwords, $2.99/mo unlimited. The Env Vault is the differentiator: drop your project folder and Lemonade detectsenv files, credentials — everything you can't commit to git.

records.name: Anima
records.tagline: UX Design Agent | Design to Code
records.description: From rough ideas to Figma files, Anima’s AI generates accurate frontend code that matches your design system. Say goodbye to generic code agents - build real, responsive UI that’s on-brand and ready to ship.

records.name: Dock 3.0
records.tagline: Optimize, track & grow your apps now w/ Google Play support
records.description: Dock is the ASO & Growth Manager for macOS built by an indie dev who uses it every day. Manage App Store and Google Play metadata with real-time keyword analysis, popularity scoring, and AI-powered suggestions. Spy on competitors with App Intelligence, downloads, revenue, keyword rankings, and social links. Track how your changes impact rankings with App Evolution. Manage screenshots, in-app events, reviews, and financials in one place. Connect AI via MCP Server for hands-free optimization.

records.name: What YC Is Really Betting On?
records.tagline: An X-ray of 793 YC startups
records.description: What does the average YC company actually look like? I scraped 793 startups and 1,625 founder bios from the last 5 batches to find out. 27 interactive charts covering: which industries are surging, which are dying, what founders have in common, how partners pick companies, hidden themes in descriptions, and the exact statistical profile of a "default" YC startup. Some surprises: YC funds direct competitors in the same batch. And every partner has a type. Free. No login

records.name: toktrack
records.tagline: Track AI CLI spending across Claude, Codex & Gemini in 40ms
records.description: toktrack scans your AI coding CLI session files and shows exactly how much you're spending — per model, per day. Works with Claude Code, Codex CLI (including gpt-5.3-codex), Gemini CLI, and OpenCode. One command: npx toktrack. Built in Rust with SIMD JSON parsing — scans 3,500+ session files in ~40ms. It also caches your cost history independently, so even after Claude Code deletes sessions (default 30 days), your data is preserved. Free and open source (MIT).

records.name: ClawRecipes
records.tagline: Save 50+ hours setting up OpenClaw Agents with ClawRecipes
records.description: 🔥 Introducing ClawRecipes 🦞 — Recipes for OpenClaw that actually work Tired of agent teams that don’t collaborate? ClawRecipes is the first plugin for real out-of-the-box multi-agent teams One command: openclaw recipes scaffold development-team You get: • Full team (Lead, Dev, DevOps, Test) with roles & workflows • Kanban board & shared context • Auto-dispatch, cron jobs, role guardrails • Recipe Marketplace Also recipes for support, research, product, social + single agents 🦞🔥

records.name: Just The Article Please
records.tagline: A simple article reader for the web
records.description: A simple article reader for the web. Read articles without clutter. Add "justthearticleplease.com/" or "jtap.cc/" before an article URL and read in visual peace. Or, if you prefer, visit the site, and enter an article url. Oh, there's also a nice "Copy just the article link" link so you can share it with friends and colleagues. Enjoy! Readingly, Jonathan Ad-Free

records.name: Gemma
records.tagline: AI personal assistant that calls you with reminders
records.description: Gemma calls you with reminders instead of sending notifications. Syncs with Google Calendar, natural voice conversations, smart rescheduling. Built because my wife ignores every notification but answers every phone call. 2000+ calls made in testing. Works when notifications fail.

records.name: mygrowthbox.com
records.tagline: The leading martech comparison platform
records.description: MyGrowthBox is the go-to platform for optimizing your marketing strategy with the latest AI innovations. We analyze emerging trends in AI-driven marketing, review the most powerful tools, and provide an independent comparison platform to help you make smarter decisions. Built for the French market, MyGrowthBox is the only dedicated martech comparison platform in France, offering curated insights tailored to local needs.

records.name: EV Charger Finder
records.tagline: The EV Charger finder website you are looking for
records.description: ⚡️ Stop the "Range Anxiety"! ⚡️ Tired of driving around looking for a working EV charger? I’ve built a tool to make finding your next charge effortless. 🔗 https://evstationfinder.vercel.app Why use it? Instant Search: Find stations near you in seconds. Live Updates: No more arriving at broken chargers. User Feedback: Real tips from other EV owners. Spend less time searching and more time driving. Check it out and let me know what you think! 🔋🚗 #EVLife #ElectricVehicle #CleanEnergy

records.name: SaaSAnalytics
records.tagline: Analytics, attribution & AI – built for SaaS teams
records.description: Most SaaS teams have data everywhere. Google Analytics for traffic. Stripe for revenue. Slack for alerts. Zapier for automations. Intercom for chat. Nothing actually talks to each other. SaaSAnalytics brings analytics, attribution, onboarding automation, and AI chat support into one clean dashboard. See what’s driving revenue. Spot where users drop off. Automatically nudge them back. No switching tools. No messy stack.

records.name: Outreach Rater
records.tagline: Your cold outreach is RAW. Chef Gordon will tell you why.
records.description: Paste your cold outreach message and let Gordon Ramsay roast it. Get brutally honest feedback and learn how to actually fix it.

records.name: VCaptio
records.tagline: AI subtitles for 99 languages — transcribe, edit, export
records.description: VCaptio is an AI-powered subtitle platform that handles the full workflow — from speech recognition to styled export. What makes it different: - Visual drag-and-drop timeline editor — not a raw text file - Full style control: font, color, stroke, shadow, position - Context-aware AI translation that preserves tone - Export at original video quality Free to try (15 min/month, no credit card). Pay-as-you-go after that — $0.03/min.

records.name: TrustThis
records.tagline: Open platform for software privacy scoring and AI governance
records.description: Compare software privacy with ISO and LGPD criteria. Automated AI analysis, category rankings, and objective scores.

records.name: Habyl
records.tagline: Property inspection reports in 10 min, even offline
records.description: Habyl is a multi-platform app (iOS, Android, Web) that lets real estate professionals create property inspection reports in 10 minutes - even fully offline. Our AI analyzes your photos and auto-fills room details (furniture, condition, equipment). Import old paper reports via AI. Generate legally compliant PDFs with eIDAS qualified timestamps. Free to use, pay only when you generate a PDF.

records.name: Thai Visa Checklist
records.tagline: Free Visa Document Checklists for Thailand
records.description: Thai Visa Checklist is a free web app that helps foreigners apply for Thailand visas without relying on paid agents. Get clear, step-by-step document checklists for marriage and retirement visas, plus guides for 90-day reporting, address registration, and re-entry permits. Built for expats who are tired of outdated and unclear immigration information. Never miss a document again.

records.name: Resumate
records.tagline: Turn your job hunt into a 5-minute task with ATS-proof AI.
records.description: Build a professional, ATS-optimized resume in minutes with our AI technology. Professional templates and instantly downloadable as PDF.

records.name: Mock-up Buzz - 3D Mock-ups Made Easy
records.tagline: A free tool to create your own branded 3D mock-ups
records.description: This is a free tool with no watermarking or branding (except your own if you want it). The interface is easy to use and there are lots of customisation options. You can also easily add text to your mock-ups.

records.name: SOCYiD
records.tagline: Share Less. Meet Smarter.
records.description: Most apps help you connect online but don’t get you from chat to a meetup. SOCYiD is the missing step for any dating, marketplace, or social app—one place to message and plan without giving out your phone number or unlimited access to socials. Share your SOCYiD ID (your universal meetup ID) and a time-limited social Passport with optional ID verification, trust score, and reputation that carries forward. Pick partner meetup spots with GPS, confirm arrival—so first meetups aren't just guesswork.

records.name: LeadBuddie
records.tagline: WhatsApp CRM for High Enquiry Teams
records.description: LeadBuddie is a WhatsApp-first CRM built for businesses that receive many customer enquiries daily. It helps teams organize chats, assign conversations, track leads, and manage follow-ups using their existing WhatsApp number. With shared inbox, pipeline view, campaigns, and AI-assisted replies, businesses can respond faster and avoid missing customers. Ideal for service businesses where conversations drive sales.

records.name: Vettly
records.tagline: AI voice agent that automates first-round interviews
records.description: Vettly automates your first-round interviews with an AI voice agent that schedules, conducts, and ranks candidates — so you can focus on hiring the best.

records.name: LiteSOC
records.tagline: Security observability for startups without the complexity.
records.description: LiteSOC redefines security observability for startups by removing the complexity of traditional SIEMs. Unlike existing tools, it integrates in just two minutes via a simple REST API with no heavy agents. Standout features include a smart normalizer that auto-standardizes 26 event types and a behavioral AI engine that instantly detects impossible travel and geo-anomalies. With built-in forensic maps and VPN detection, LiteSOC provides enterprise-grade insights at a fraction of the cost.

records.name: Zypher
records.tagline: Model your next move
records.description: Zypher is an AI decision engine inspired by ancient royal modeling systems. We don’t do vague advice. Every dilemma is processed into three weighted strategic paths, exposing confidence distributions and risk signals. Speculation ends where calculation begins.
